description:
The young girls were welcomed and honored with traditional worship rituals, symbolizing reverence for divine feminine power.
₹25,000 was sponsored by Mumbai Kalakar
Distributed books , pens , folders, frooti, biscuits all make up, clips & rubber bands items & mouth watering Chinese bhel & dabeli tokens of appreciation, and festive offerings to all 125 participating children, ensuring a joyful celebration.
